protocol.early_gate: Original VM+JIT title pair only:3warmups+11 rotating/alternating fresh-process pairs; geometric median latency ratio<=0.97 and each row median/P90 ratio<=1.05. Aspirational pair ratio<=0.90 is separate. Native executables must be byte-identical to accepted controls before timing; no Native speedup is claimed by this VM-only step. Failed early minimum rejects without favorable rerun.
protocol.full_gate: All32 ON/OFF paired3+11 after full appropriate validation. ON sum of medians ratio<=1.00; OFF<=1.01. Any row median/P90 ratio>1.05 gets exactly one fixed confirmation; repeat of same metric rejects. All32 Native correctness and byte-identical Native controls are required. If Native identity differs, investigate before timing; do not silently substitute a weaker control. All original inputs,114hashes,arguments,outputs,64MiB and host-monitor rules retained. Fresh five-way comparison after local acceptance only; no global parity claim.
protocol.design: Start from accepted production, with no rejected whole-array proof or binding-size/emitter changes. Existing checked string-cell bridge validates every child exactly as before. It always publishes complete reference, bytes/length and VM target. Only if nonzero context entry epoch equals destination binding epoch may already initialized execution/function/layout/type/heap epoch and entry epoch stores be omitted. Miss/zero epoch performs full original publication. Existing native-entry setup increments epoch after every cold boundary/native call/return and globally clears all binding tables on wrap; overwritten references invalidate affected entries. No borrowed lifetime is extended; no new allocation/root/metadata; retain full observable and internal destination state.
protocol.validation: New focused C17 owner compares actual checked/proven and metered/unmetered native reads with an independent copy of the accepted complete checked C publication. Same-entry repeated empty/NUL/Unicode reads exercise metadata reuse; absent/zero/mismatched entry proof uses full publication, including deliberately stale metadata. Selected malformed full reference and wrong object preserve entire destination/resource record. New native entries after mutation/reserve/GC/failedGC/saturation and actual epoch wrap refresh complete state; retain existing ownership/views/aliases/calls/roots tests. Repeated straight-line original VM/program differential sweeps finite/shared/SIZE_MAX fuel and every deterministic allocation-failure index, both zero ledgers. Six gates,18 focused ON plus5 OFF, all32 Native/ON/OFF outputs and Native byte identity before fixed3+11 early pair. Full appropriate105/89 CTest,22 sanitizer and22 Rosetta plus all32 outputs only if early passes; derive inventories. All32 ON/OFF fixed timing and fresh five-way only on local acceptance.
